description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Token class, which handles creation, encoding, decoding, and verification of tokens and hashed passwords using Argon2 and base64 encoding.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Token
classes.description: A class for generating, encoding, decoding, and verifying tokens and hashed passwords using Argon2 and base64 encoding.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new token object with a random token value.

methods.name: from_string
methods.description: Creates a token object from a given string.

methods.name: from_base64
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string and creates a token object from it.

methods.name: to_base64
methods.description: Encodes the token value to a base64 string.

methods.name: to_salted_hash
methods.description: Generates a salted hash of the token using Argon2.

methods.name: verify_salted_hash
methods.description: Verifies the token against a salted hash using Argon2.

methods.name: _random_bytes
methods.description: Generates a specified number of cryptographically secure random bytes.
